Bill.BriefDescription: Administering funds received under the Help America Vote Act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the election account; and adding a new sectionto chapter 29.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The election account is created in the state treasury, to beadministered by the secretary of state. The following money must bedeposited into this account: (a) Amounts received from the federal government under Public Law107252 (October 29, 2002), known as the "Help America Vote Act of2002," including any amounts received under subsequent amendments tothe act; (b) Amounts appropriated or otherwise made available by the statelegislature for the purposes of carrying out activities for whichfederal funds are provided to the state under Public Law 107252,including any amounts received under subsequent amendments to the act; (c) Such other amounts as may be appropriated by the legislature tothe account. p. 1 HB 1161 (2) All earnings, including interest, from investments of balancesin the election account will be credited to the election account, andmay be used only for election accountrelated purposes. (3) The secretary of state shall allot the funds in the accountexclusively to facilitate the implementation of Public Law 107252.
